description: Which official Claude Academy material this repository catalogs. The freshness checker uses these rules so that out-of-scope material is counted but does not raise a weekly alert.
rationale: Claude Academy publishes a broad tutorial library that includes vertical, partner, and connector-specific guides. Agent Fieldbook catalogs general Claude and Codex product workflows, so vertical material is tracked as out of scope instead of being added to the catalog.
exclude_note: Excluded slugs are industry-vertical or partner-integration guides (financial services, life sciences, nonprofit partnerships, and per-connector how-tos). Remove a pattern here to bring that material back into the catalog.
